title: Letter & Report On Mr. Charles Jacobson

page_data.en:
S.B. D.147I

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. L. REGIST.
No. S. B. D. 1471.
Date 29 - 7 - 30.

July 29, 30.

Dear Hill,

With reference to your memo of
July 22, 1930, I have to inform you that
Mr. Charles Jacobson is at present residing
at No. 1552 Avenue Joffre, apartment No. 603,
which is occupied by Mr. & Mrs. S. Trevor Smith.
Mrs. Trevor Smith is Jacobson's daughter.

Yours sincerely,

J. C. Hill Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处
编号 S. B. D. 1471.
日期 30年7月29日。

1930年7月29日。

亲爱的希尔：

关于您1930年7月22日的备忘录，特此告知，查尔斯·雅各布森（Charles Jacobson）先生目前居住在霞飞路1552号603室，该寓所由S. 特雷弗·史密斯（S. Trevor Smith）夫妇居住。特雷弗·史密斯夫人是雅各布森的女儿。

此致

敬礼

J. C. 希尔 先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

File No.
S. B. D. 1111 / 1
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch No. 2. Station,
REPORT
Date July 29, 1930.
Subject (in full) C. Jacobson.
Made by — and — Forwarded by D.S.I. Duncan.
Sir,
With reference to attached memorandum dated July
22nd 1930 from H.B.M. Consulate re: C. Jacobson,
enquiries show that he arrived in Shanghai in the
S.S. "Hoten Maru" on July 20th.
He is residing at No. 1552 Avenue Joffre,
apartment 603, which is occupied by Mr. and Mrs.
S. Trevor Smith. Mrs. Trevor Smith is his daughter.
W. Duncan.
D. S. I.
D. C.
(C. & S. Branches)
Reg. Please despatch letter
in above sense.
29.7.'30.
